{{Quote|If I win, you ''release'' Master Plo. And if you win&hellip; Ahsoka and I will ''also'' become your prisoners.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Drez Unlin]]|<ref name="TMR">{{SWComicCite|7.3|The Masked Racer}}</ref>}}
A '''prisoner''' was a term for an individual incarcerated in a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] or a similar facility.

==History==
[[File:Charal_imprisoned.png|thumb|left|200px|The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]] behind the bars]]
An individual would become a prisoner in order to be prevented from continuing actions that the imprisoning body deemed unacceptable. Unacceptable behaviors that resulted in imprisonment varied depending on culture and local laws; common reasons for incarceration ranged from [[Politics/Legends|political]] activity to [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorism]], from major to minor crimes. In addition, prisoners of war were individuals who were imprisoned by their enemies as a result of their opposing affiliation.

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were known to have kept prisoners, but did not believe in executing their prisoners. [[Volfe Karkko]], an [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], experienced typical Jedi imprisonment procedures when he was held in a [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis field]], a device that only a Jedi could be capable of opening. In this [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]], Karkko's mind was left conscious to contemplate the atrocities he had committed, and his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was left with him to serve as a warning of the consequences of arrogance.

The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] commonly [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] their prisoners for sport, after interrogating them for any useful information they might have. The [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] at the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]], under the control of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Empire]], often kept their own store of captive [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on whom they practiced their [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|skills]] with a lightsaber as well as their powers of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Ironically the same Revan was put in stasis by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] for up to 300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]].

The anti-alien [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] often used their prisoners, who were often a number of different sentient species, for [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] labor on a number of planets, such as [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Artus Prime]] and for construction projects such as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].
